We don’t just build technology. We build hope for everyone dealing with Cancer.
 Elekta is shaping the standard of care, together with healthcare providers, by developing precision radiation medicine that brings advanced radiotherapy into routine clinical practice. Our solutions support consistent, efficient and personalized care, addressing evolving patient needs. Through adaptive radiotherapy, precision treatment delivery and integrated workflows, Elekta supports care teams across a range of clinical settings. Each year more than 2 million patients are treated using Elekta solutions across over 130 countries. Elekta is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, with over 4,000 employees and offices in more than 40 countries. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. For more information, visit elekta.com.
 Software Upgrade Specialist
 What You’ll Do At Elekta
 As a Software Upgrade Specialist, you will deliver technical software upgrades for Elekta customers across Europe, from planning and installation through testing, validation and go-live support. Upgrades are delivered remotely and on customer sites, and you will work closely with customers, project managers, trainers, engineers, distributors and technical service colleagues to help ensure each upgrade is completed safely, professionally and with minimal disruption to clinical treatments.
This is a customer-facing role requiring significant flexibility. Travel of up to 50% across Europe may be required, including travel at short notice. Upgrade activities are frequently scheduled outside standard working hours and at weekends, with up to 75% of weekends potentially scheduled for customer upgrade activities. When you are not performing upgrades, you may provide technical advice and support to colleagues.
 Responsibilities
Deliver all technical aspects of assigned software upgrade activities, both remotely and at customer sites. 
Keep customers and the Upgrade Project Manager informed of progress, risks and issues throughout upgrade activities. 
Prepare, maintain and submit the documentation, reports, backups and signed records required to support software upgrades in line with quality procedures. 
Support customer acceptance testing and complete software upgrade documentation and process sign-off within the scope of the role. 
Provide post-upgrade support to customers, Elekta trainers and project managers, including questions or issues arising during testing, validation and go-live. 
Be available, as required, to support calls from customers, Elekta engineers and distributors related to upgrades. 
Escalate technical issues that may become significant, including issues that could prevent or delay software rollouts. 
Keep relevant Elekta business teams and distributors updated on the progress of issues being managed. 
Perform installation work and software upgrades at customer sites and remotely as required. 
Travel at short notice when needed to help resolve technical or customer-site issues. 
Maintain a safe, organised and effective working environment when working remotely or at customer locations, including appropriate risk assessments. 
Carry out work in accordance with Elekta quality, regulatory and safety policies and promptly report issues that could affect project delivery, system reliability or personnel safety. 
When not engaged in scheduled upgrade activities, support the Technical Service Department with technical advice, remote or office-based support, and other relevant tasks. 
 What You’ll Bring
Degree or diploma in Computer Science, or equivalent relevant work experience. 
Strong technical knowledge across PC and network computing environments, including SQL, Citrix, Microsoft cloud solutions, storage configuration, virtualization, Active Directory and Windows operating systems. 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with customers and colleagues both in Polish and English. 
Demonstrated customer care skills and a professional, service-oriented approach. 
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment while also managing your own workload and maintaining technical knowledge independently. 
Flexibility to travel up to 50% across Europe and to work outside standard hours, including scheduled weekend upgrade activities. 
Experience in a technical support environment is desirable. 
Knowledge of healthcare environments is desirable. 
Commitment to following Elekta quality, regulatory and safety policies and representing Elekta professionally in all customer interactions. 
 What You’ll Get
 From Day One 
Private medical care (Medicover) 
Group life insurance 
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering psychological and legal support 
Multikafeteria benefits platform, including access to the Multisport card 
 After Successful Completion of the Probation Period 
Employee Pension Plan (PPE) 
Annual Global Bonus Plan 
Employee discounts platform 
Employee referral program 
 Application process 
 We look forward to receiving your application. Please submit your CV in English via the “Apply” button. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
